description: This file contains the class 'FormulaParser', which is responsible for parsing Excel-like formulas into tokens within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for character tokens, methods for tokenizing formula strings, and handling of various formula components such as strings, errors, functions, operators, and subexpressions.

classes.name: FormulaParser
classes.description: A class used for parsing Excel formulas into tokens for further analysis or processing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the FormulaParser with an optional formula string and triggers parsing into tokens.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Returns the original formula string being parsed.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token by its index from the parsed token list.

methods.name: getTokenCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tokens parsed from the formula.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Returns all tokens parsed from the formula as an array.

methods.name: parseToTokens
methods.description: Private method that performs the actual parsing of the formula string into tokens, handling string literals, errors, functions, operators, and subexpressions.
